currentParagraphText: “Oh?” the Sword Saint exclaimed surprised. He looked at the succubus, but she looked equally confused, making him believe she hadn’t been the one to tip them off he was visiting.

finalResult.nextParagraphText: “We are aware of your clan, including the presence of vampires within it,” the man explained. “The Patriarch has looked forward to your visit for a long time, and I hope you will accept his invitation.”
